question: Who was the founding director of BARC Mumbai?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Homi Jehangir Bhabha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Homi Jehangir Bhabh**a was an Indian nuclear physicist, founding director, and professor of physics at the** Tata Institute of Fundamental Research.**
 
• Dr. Bhabha established the Atomic Energy Establishment, (AEET), **Trombay, Mumbai** in January 1954.
 
• AEET was subsequently renamed **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Vikram Ambalal Sarabhai** was an Indian physicist and astronomer who initiated space research and helped develop nuclear power in India. Honored with** Padma Bhushan in 1966** and the **Padma Vibhushan in 1972**. He is regarded as the Father of the Indian Space Program
 
• **Satish Dhawan** was an Indian mathematician and aerospace engineer, widely regarded as the father of experimental fluid dynamics research in India.
 
• **Raja Ramanna **was an Indian physicist who is best known for his role in India's nuclear program. **Ramanna worked under Homi Jehangir Bhabha** and later became the director of this program in 1967
